question: In which year was the Hindu Succession Act of 1956 amended to give equal right to father's property to daughters?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Hindu Succession Act of 1956 was **amended to give equal rights to fathers' property to daughters in the **year 2005**.
 
• Section 6 of the Hindu Succession Act of 1956 which deals with the participant's right in acquiring the property
